To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we prepared a novel mixed matrix membrane by synergistically integrating graphene oxide and zeolitic framework in a glassy polymer for selective carbon dioxide capture from post combustion flues gas.
the synergistic effect of graphene oxide and Zif-301 nanofiller improved CO 2 separation properties of PSF membrane.
the synergistic effect of GO and ZIF 302 nanosheets in PSF matrix resulted in high performance composite membrane for CO 2 capture from flue gas with excellent separation performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of high performance MMMs using GO and ZIF 302 for selective CO 2 separation.
the development of a new generation of mixed matrix membranes with high performance, high selectivity and stability in humid condition.
the development of a high performance mixed matrix membrane for CO 2 capture from flue gas.

the synergistic effect of GO and ZIF 31 in polysulfone matrix can be utilized to develop high-performance membranes for selective separation of carbon dioxide from flue gas.
the developed composite membranes have high potential for industrial application.
GO and ZIF 302 synergistically improved CO 2 separation characteristics of glassy polysulfonate membranes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
synergistic integration of GO and ZIF 31 into PSF resulted in the development of high performance MMMs for selective CO 2 separation.
the prepared MMMs could be a potential candidate for industrial application of CO 2 capture.
GO/ZIF 301 nanofillers synergistically integrated into glassy polymer matrix can improve CO 2 permeance and CO 2/N 2 selectivity in a synergistic way.

the synergistic effect of GO and ZIF 302 nanofillers in glassy polymers is a promising approach to design high performance MMMs for CO 2 capture applications.
the synergistic effect of GO and ZIF 302 in PSF membrane is a promising approach to develop high performance MMMs for selective CO 2 separation.
